import struct, subprocess, os, tempfile, pathlib
# brute force a few small headers for crash under submit harness? just generate variants and run submit.

      buf += struct.pack('>I', 1)
    buf += b'\x81'
    fn=f'/tmp/poc_{y}_{z}.bin'
    open(fn,'wb').write(buf)
    variants.append(fn)
print('\n'.join(variants[:5]))
